answer: Hardware-bound quotas. For agents cataloguing a relic, mapping a ridge, or monitoring an orchard, accept one reward slot per certified security chip each epoch. The verifier checks a manufacturer attestation and rejects reused device identifiers, even across accounts. Opening N accounts on one chip yields one slot; N slots require buying or renting N chips and paying their upkeep. This assumes unique manufacturer credentials and nonextractable keys. Forged certificates or cloned hardware would break the limit.
